text: Paper and book atlas / 1992 Dynamics of Fronts in Thermally Bistable Fluids Elphick, Regev & Shaviv · 1992 ApJ 392, 106–117 Reference listed · scope proposed Isobaric conductive fronts, a Lyapunov functional, equal-depth potential minima and interacting cloud boundaries. Scope in this archive. The source equations are reviewed; no numerical reproduction yet. Candidate: the cubic benchmark, static kink or front speed versus potential-depth difference, retaining the Lagrangian mass coordinate and state-dependent mobility. Source review: Original scan pp.108–109, Eq.2.14, Eqs3.2–3.6 and Figure1 visually checked. The paper allows general bistable cooling; the earlier Elphick–Regev–Spiegel1991 model used a cubic approximation. Source notes and related resources.
